properties.notes: Potential opportunity for redevelopment of a garage site within the urban area. Existing business remains in situ and operational, and is therefore not immediately available, but longer-term potential for residential development on wider site remains following clearance. An application was permitted for change of use from residential to business use, resulting in loss of one dwelling (14/00246/COU). Despite this it is still considered to offer potential in the medium- to longer-term.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
